'''Philo''' was the brother to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Reglis Taal]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was hunted and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Raxine]] and [[Krestock]]. However, the posting had been a mistake. Reglis Taal subsequently killed Krestock in retaliation.
